title: Berlin Clock - Quick Summary
items: **Read the Berlin clock from the top down** and add up the lit lamps. The round top lamp only blinks and does not count.
**The two red rows are hours:** each lamp in row 1 is 5 hours, each lamp in row 2 is 1 hour.
**The two lower rows are minutes:** each lamp in row 3 is 5 minutes, each lamp in row 4 is 1 minute.
**Red lamps in row 3 mark 15, 30 and 45 minutes,** so you can find the quarter at a glance.
**It runs on the 24-hour day.** Two, four, seven and two lit lamps make 14:37.
**Find it at Budapester Straße 45,** on the back of the Europa-Center, about six minutes on foot from Zoologischer Garten. It is free and stands on the street.
**Stop by on the way, after dark if you can.** It takes two minutes, so I would pair it with a walk to KaDeWe or along the Ku'damm.
